title: Food Allergy Checklist
subtitle: Capture guest-stated allergen, menu item, kitchen communication, and cross-contact limit; confirm manager review and service handoff.
description: Food Allergy records guest-stated allergen, menu item, kitchen communication, cross-contact limit, manager review, and service handoff. Food Allergy evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this food allergy stage-gated verification when staff must document guest-stated allergen and menu item. Reconcile kitchen communication, cross-contact limit, manager review, and service handoff before the food allergy handoff. Use the guest statement, approved ingredient source, recipe or package review, allergy ticket, kitchen read-back, manager check, server handoff, service result, and follow-up. Ask the assigned food allergy reviewer to confirm guest-stated allergen against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Guest, order, and allergen details
sections.guidance: Record the guest's wording and the exact meal or service reference.

sections.title: Kitchen and cross-contact checks
sections.guidance: Check the current recipe, preparation controls, and service read-back.

blocks.label: Culinary and service checks
items: Guest statement is read back without adding a diagnosis
Menu item matches the current recipe or package source
Every ingredient and planned substitution is reviewed
Preparation area, tools, gloves, and fryer limits are checked
Cross-contact limits are communicated without a guarantee
Allergy flag appears on the kitchen ticket or approved system
Kitchen lead repeats the instruction to the service lead
Manager reviews unresolved ingredient or cross-contact questions
Guest is told any limitation before the order is accepted
Final plate or service handoff is confirmed by name or reference

fields.label: Source checked, substitution, cross-contact limit, and guest communication

sections.title: Service handoff and outcome
sections.guidance: Identify who accepted the instruction and what the guest was told.

blocks.label: Manager and service receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms the operating handoff and stated limits.

blocks.label: Allergy communication boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not promise an allergen-free environment. Stop and ask the authorized culinary or safety reviewer when an ingredient or cross-contact question remains.
